objective: Prevent empty or structurally incomplete same-day moneyflow_dc and cyq_perf responses from becoming immutable successful source batches while preserving a small, explicit tolerance for legitimate issuer-level source omissions.
non_goals: Do not modify production runtime state or any existing SQLite batch.
Do not implement or authorize historical supersession or migration records.
Do not change quarterly fina_indicator_pit empty-response semantics.
Do not weaken E1 red flags, U3 completeness, or Junyan-only U4 selection.
Do not repair FF-2 through FF-5 in this PR.
dependencies: PR #311 migration plan v0.1 review requirements
input_contracts: Tushare moneyflow_dc and cyq_perf by trade_date
output_artifacts: Retryable SOURCE_PUBLICATION_PENDING receipt for empty or under-covered daily responses
Behavior-level negative regressions and mutation-gate coverage
acceptance_tests: Prove empty moneyflow_dc and cyq_perf responses write neither source batches nor source rows.
Prove a daily response below the declared 95 percent expected-universe coverage floor remains SOURCE_PUBLICATION_PENDING.
Prove a later complete retry for the same source and date ingests normally and remains idempotent afterward.
Prove a response meeting the coverage floor may commit explicit issuer-level SOURCE_ROW_MISSING gaps.
Prove quarterly fina_indicator_pit empty-response behavior is unchanged.
Prove weakening the daily-source registry or coverage floor makes dedicated regressions and mutation cases fail.
Run the semiconductor input suite, no-network guard, mutation-gate selftests, and exact-head CI before merge.
approval_gates: Independent adversarial review is required before merge.
Historical source repair requires a separate append-only migration/data PR after this guard is merged.
No production deployment or runtime write is authorized by this task.
